title: Units
$comment: Units, one file each under `data_types/units/`: the unit a physical value is measured in, an element a type names by reference. One kind, `unit`, which an application type names as its `unit_ref` and a `linear` compu method as its `unit`. The directory is mandatory and may be empty.

name.description: The unit's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/units/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the units, must not be blank, and immutable; an element of another layer may carry the same name.

display_name.description: The text the unit is shown as (for example `km/h`), written as the `UNIT`'s `DISPLAY-NAME` exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

description.description: Free text about the unit. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

package.description: The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/Units`, its layer's package, this unit is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the unit and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/Units/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/Units` itself. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule.
